About the author

Sarah Thornton is a sociologist and author of four critically acclaimed books. Thornton was once hailed as “Britain’s hippest academic” and then lauded as “the Jane Goodall of the art world.” Her book "Seven Days in the Art World" is an international bestseller, available in 22 languages. Thornton was a scholar-in-residence at the University of California, Berkeley, for three years while writing her latest book about the culture of breasts. Author Mary Roach says that Thornton has a "double D brain."
